verdict.rationale: Terminal documents an API-based (server-driven) integration with a built-in simulated card reader, so integrations can be developed and tested without physical hardware. This supports headless automation, and the Stripe CLI adds terminal-based build and test tooling. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly documents CI pipeline usage or unattended automation workflows for Terminal. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless automation documentation for Terminal, Terminal-specific CLI commands for simulated readers, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Stripe Terminal SDKs and server-driven integration come with a built-in simulated card reader, so you can develop and test your app without connecting to physical hardware.
Terminal supports an API-based integration in addition to SDKs for Android, iOS, JavaScript, and React Native.
The Stripe CLI helps you build, test, and manage your Stripe integration right from the terminal.
